content.text: Kubernetes environments began to be used in earnest in the market about two or three years ago. Because a systematic environment has not been established, problems often occur during use, such as massive resources being consumed and security management not being easy.

To solve this problem, QueryPie stepped up directly! In Episode 4, we explored how to maintain a robust security environment even in Kubernetes environments by utilizing "QueryPie KAC (Kubernetes Access Controller)," QueryPie's Kubernetes access control solution.
How to efficiently manage clusters in a Kubernetes environment
Granular resource access management (Namespaces, Pods, Deployments, ReplicaSets)
"QueryPie KAC" enables efficient security management even in Kubernetes environments. For detailed usage, please check [Ch. QueryPie: 3-Stage Side Kick]!
